text:
Europe’s top five leagues delivered plenty of drama in the latest round, marked by several surprise away wins and unexpected upsets for traditional heavyweights. Across all five leagues, recent results tested both the model and Bet365 with a chaotic set of fixtures.

There are no high expected value opportunities of ten percent or more flagged for upcoming matches in this round.

In the Premier League, the model made a sharp call in Fulham’s 1-0 win at Coventry, rating the away side at a strong 59.7% chance compared to Bet365’s 2.25 odds. It also assessed Aston Villa’s 2-1 victory over Manchester City better than the bookmaker, giving Villa a 28.6% chance against Bet365’s distant 5.0 odds. Over in the Bundesliga, heavy home backing paid off for Leipzig with a 74.2% win chance and Dortmund with a 73.5% win chance, though Borussia Moenchengladbach’s 3-2 win at Stuttgart caught the model off guard after it gave the hosts a 67.0% chance.

Serie A provided some of the model’s strongest calls. It gave Inter a massive 91.5% chance to beat Venezia, yielding a superior log loss of 0.089 compared to Bet365’s 0.359, while also nailing Napoli’s 4-1 victory at Monza with an 80.1% probability. In La Liga, Real Madrid’s 2-1 Clasico victory at Barcelona caught out the model, which had given Barcelona a 64.9% chance. Finally, in Ligue 1, the model comfortably outscored Bet365 on Lens's 2-1 win over Paris FC, recording a 0.599 log loss against the bookmaker's 0.946.
